resources.string: Mode: audio-coupled haptics — actuator driven with a true 128 Hz sine wave (output is attenuated off-resonance).
Mode: native motor — this device has no haptic audio channel, so vibration plays at the motor\'s own resonant frequency, NOT 128 Hz.
This device has no usable vibration output.

For research/educational use only. This is NOT a certified medical device and must not be used for diagnosis. A phone cannot reproduce a calibrated 128 Hz tuning fork: on supported devices the app drives the actuator with a 128 Hz sine via the haptic audio channel (attenuated off-resonance); otherwise it falls back to the motor\'s native frequency.
